question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Ruthless
solution:
The correct answer is Option (4) i.e. '**Lenient**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ruthless (निर्दयी) **- Having or showing no pity or compassion for others.

 
 
• **Example**: The ruthless dictator did not care about the plight of his people.
 
 
 
• **Lenient (सौम्य)** - More merciful or tolerant than expected.
 
 
• **Example**: The teacher was lenient and gave them an extra day to submit the assignment.
 
 
 
• Hence, '**Lenient**' is the antonym of the given word '**Ruthless**'

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Lenient**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Resolute (दृढ़)** - Admirably purposeful, determined, and unwavering.

 
 
• **Example**: She was resolute in her decision to pursue a career in acting.
 
 
 
• **Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण)** - Unfriendly or antagonistic.
 
 
• **Example**: His hostile attitude made it difficult for his colleagues to work with him.
 
 
 
• **Affluent (धनी)** - Having a lot of money and possessions.
 
 
• **Example**: The affluent businessman donated a large sum of money to the charity.
